text.card: A star about 150 parsecs away, 4.7 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.7 solar radii and 1.14 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,799 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 206610
quotes.card: HD 206610, also known as Bosona, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet in the constellation of Aquarius.
quotes.introduction: Based on parallax measurements, it is located at a distance of approximately 482 light years from the Sun.
